project.boundarySource: ONS Built-up Areas (December 2024) with curated adjoining public green spaces
project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 2224 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 0 of 785 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Destination draw
touristAppeal.summary: Shrewsbury has destination-scale depth led by Ditherington Flax Mill, Former Her Majesty's Prison Shrewsbury, Shrewsbury Museum (The Music Hall) and Shrewsbury - Dingle & Quarry Park, with enough independent visitor experiences for most of a day.

townGuide.headline: Shrewsbury: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Shrewsbury offers Ditherington Flax Mill, Former Her Majesty's Prison Shrewsbury, Shrewsbury Museum (The Music Hall) within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Ditherington Flax Mill
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Ditherington Flax Mill and Former Her Majesty's Prison Shrewsbury, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
